source.trial: This interview uses your free {{minutes}}-minute trial.
source.held: Already paid for: reconnecting does not use another interview.

room.lengthChanged_one: This call runs {{count}} minute, not {{promised}}: what pays for it changed since the page opened (a credit or an interview was used elsewhere).
room.lengthChanged_other: This call runs {{count}} minutes, not {{promised}}: what pays for it changed since the page opened (a credit or an interview was used elsewhere).

dropped.noStarts: There are no starts left for this interview.
dropped.at: Your call dropped at {{at}}. You have {{left}} left.
dropped.resume: Reconnect and the interviewer picks up where you left off. If you don't come back within 10 minutes, the interview is scored with what you said.
dropped.noTime: There is too little time left to reconnect. The interview is scored with what you said.
dropped.silent_one: Your call dropped before you answered. You can start again with the full {{count}} minute.
dropped.silent_other: Your call dropped before you answered. You can start again with the full {{count}} minutes.
dropped.early: The interview ended early. You still have {{left}}.
dropped.earlyResume: Continue and the interviewer picks up where you left off, or finish now and get your feedback.

hint.live: Speak naturally. End the interview whenever you are done.
hint.idle: The questions come from the posting and your analysis.

countdown.warning: Last minute. The interviewer keeps asking until the time is up.
countdown.closing: Time's up. Finish your answer; the interviewer will say goodbye and close the call.

microphone.insecure: The microphone only works over a secure connection. Open this page over https and try again.
microphone.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser's site settings (the icon next to the address bar), then try again.
microphone.missing: No microphone was found. Connect one, or check that the browser can see it, then try again.
microphone.failed: The microphone could not be opened. Close other apps that may be using it and try again.

transcript.label: Live transcript
transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.emptyLive: Every finished sentence lands here as it is said.
transcript.emptyIdle: Once the call starts, the conversation is written down here as it happens.

language.label: Interview language
language.note: Proposed from the posting. The interviewer speaks and listens in the language you choose here.

queue.waiting: All interviewers are busy right now. You are in line and the call starts by itself. Waiting is not charged and does not use your interview time.
queue.short: In line for an interviewer. Nothing is charged while you wait.

offer.waiting: Payment received. Getting your interview ready…
offer.stalled: Paddle confirmed your payment, but it hasn't reached us yet. Your account page can check it again.

pro.title: You've used your free trial.
pro.titleHadVoice: Voice interviews are part of Pro.
pro.body: Go Pro to do this interview: {{perMonth}} interviews a month, up to {{minutes}} minutes each, every one scored against its posting.

pack.title: Your {{limit}} interviews renew on {{date}}.
pack.body: Want this one sooner? A pack adds {{credits}} full interviews for {{price}}. Credits never expire and work on any plan.

offer.confirming: Your purchase is being confirmed. It usually takes a few seconds; check again if it takes longer.
offer.notYet: Not confirmed yet. Give it a moment and check again.

subscription.pausedBody: Resume it in the billing portal to do this interview. A new subscription can't start while this one is open.
subscription.pending: Your Pro subscription is being updated.
subscription.pendingBody: Check it in the billing portal. A change can take a few minutes to reach us.
subscription.pastDue: Your last payment didn't go through. Update your payment method in the billing portal to keep Pro.

list.title: Every rehearsal, on the record.
list.emptyBody: Interviews start from an analysis, so the questions come from the actual job post you are applying to.
